correctness.rationale: Conditioning 2q independent exponentials on ordered row differences gives uniform affine-volume measure on the Monge slice. Differences are iid Laplace; the conditional W=min(E1,E2) is Exp(2) and independent, so 2q E[c1j]=1/2+E(D_(j))_+. The order-statistic tail integral gives R_qj as a finite rational binomial integral; reflection gives c2j. The positive distributional second derivative of the positive-part Laplace quantile gives strict discrete convexity, with q=1 and q=2 boundaries explicitly covered. R_q1=2^-q/q and R_qq=H_q-Σ(2^-r/r), yielding log edge; beta order-statistic quantiles yield bulk limit. Independently calculated rational centroids q=1..5 and checked symmetry, row totals and strict convexity, agreeing with package values at q=2,3.
